description: Data payload shape of 'runs.list' and 'runs.get' (envelope.data). runs.list fills 'runs' with every per-run log (newest first) and nulls tail/lines; runs.get returns a single-entry 'runs' plus the log tail. Log discovery follows the AGENT_MANAGER_LOG_PREFIX convention (/tmp/agent_manager_sync_<user>_<runid>.log + .latest pointer).

runs.description: Run entries: all runs for runs.list, exactly one for runs.get.

tail.description: Log tail text for runs.get, or null for runs.list.

lines.description: Number of tail lines returned by runs.get, or null for runs.list.

log_file.description: Absolute path of the per-run log.

mtime.description: ISO-8601 UTC mtime of the log file.

is_latest.description: true when the .latest pointer names this log.
